name: academic-integrity-audit-team
description: Five-specialist academic integrity audit team: lock the subject's identity, sweep all public papers and grants, forensically audit every paper, verify funding-rule compliance, and deliver a print-ready PDF audit report.

displayDescription.en: Five specialists lock the subject's identity, sweep all papers and grants, audit each paper for predatory venues and data fabrication, verify grant labeling, and deliver an evidence-chained PDF report.
displayDescription.zh: 五人分工：锁定身份、摸底全部论文与项目、逐篇取证、基金标注核验，输出可举证的 PDF 审计报告。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 审计这个人：姓名、单位、职称我给你，先确认身份，再摸底全部中英文论文和参与项目，逐篇查水刊、数据造假、挂靠代写、基金违规标注，最后出 PDF 报告
defaultInitPrompt.en: Audit this person: I'll give name, affiliation and title. Lock the identity first, then sweep all Chinese and English papers and grants, audit each paper for predatory venues, data fabrication, ghostwriting signals and grant-labeling violations, and finish with a PDF report.

quickPrompts.zh: 审计这个人：姓名、单位、职称我给你，先确认身份，再摸底全部中英文论文和参与项目，逐篇查水刊、数据造假、挂靠代写、基金违规标注，最后出 PDF 报告
quickPrompts.en: Audit this person: I'll give name, affiliation and title. Lock the identity first, then sweep all Chinese and English papers and grants, audit each paper for predatory venues, data fabrication, ghostwriting signals and grant-labeling violations, and finish with a PDF report.

quickPrompts.zh: 只做摸底：把某人的中英文论文清单和参与项目拉全，给我总量、年度分布、期刊档次和通讯作者占比
quickPrompts.en: Reconnaissance only: pull the complete Chinese and English paper list plus all grants, and report totals, year distribution, venue tiers and corresponding-author share.

quickPrompts.zh: 这篇论文标注了国自然基金号，判断是否属于无关内容标注、跨项目重复交账或虚假结题
quickPrompts.en: This paper carries an NSFC grant number — judge whether it is an off-topic labeling, a cross-grant double count, or a false final report.
